title: Global sand and gravel extraction per year
notes: UNEP's Sand and Sustainability reporting: global demand for sand and gravel rose roughly fivefold between 1970 (about 9.6 billion tonnes) and 2020 (about 50 billion tonnes), an average annual growth rate near 3.2%. The 1994 midpoint is interpolated from that reported growth rate, not a directly published data point.
